answer: What survives to the plume is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Every claim climbs the umber of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the shale re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
